irate.en: I am very angry about that!
That rule felt unfair to me.
irate.zh: 那条规则让我觉得不公平。

irate.en: Can we talk about a fair solution?
irate.zh: 我们能商量一个公平的办法吗？

irked.zh: 刚才那件事真让我心烦。

irked.en: Could you let me finish my turn?
irked.zh: 你能让我先完成这一轮吗？

irritated.en: This itchy sweater keeps bothering me.
irritated.zh: 这件毛衣扎得我不舒服。

irritated.en: Could I change into something softer?

jittery.en: I am nervous about speaking to the group.
jittery.zh: 想到要当众发言，我很紧张。

lazy.en: I do not feel like doing much.
lazy.zh: 我现在什么都不太想做。

lazy.en: I would rather lie on the sofa.
lazy.zh: 我现在只想躺在沙发上。

lazy.en: Can I have some quiet time?
lazy.zh: 我能安静地待一会儿吗？

leery.en: I am not sure I trust that.
leery.zh: 我对这件事还有些警惕。

leery.en: That story sounds strange to me.
leery.zh: 这个故事听起来有点奇怪。

leery.en: Can we check if it is true?

lethargic.en: I feel very low on energy.
lethargic.zh: 我现在一点力气都没有。

lethargic.en: Even getting up feels hard today.
Could I rest for a while?

listless.zh: 我现在对什么都提不起劲。

listless.en: I do not even want to play my favorite game.
listless.zh: 我连最喜欢的游戏都不想玩。

listless.en: Could we sit together for a bit?
listless.zh: 我们能一起坐一会儿吗？

mad.en: I did not expect that to happen.
mad.zh: 我没想到会发生那件事。

mad.en: I need a moment to calm down.

mean.zh: 我刚才那样做不太友善。

mean.en: I said something that hurt my friend's feelings.
mean.zh: 我说的话伤了朋友的心。

mean.en: Can I say sorry and try again?
mean.zh: 我能道歉，然后重新来吗？

miserable.en: Today has been full of things going wrong.
miserable.zh: 今天好多事情都不顺利。

miserable.en: Could you stay and talk with me?

mopey.en: I do not want to play like I usually do.
Can we do something quiet together?
mopey.zh: 我们能一起做点安静的事吗？

morose.en: I am in a very gloomy mood.
I do not feel like laughing today.
Would you listen if I told you why?

mournful.en: I miss someone who is not here.
mournful.zh: 我很想念不在身边的人。

mournful.en: Can we talk about our memories?
mournful.zh: 我们能聊聊以前的回忆吗？

nettled.en: That really got on my nerves.
Could you please stop doing that?

numb.en: I cannot tell what I am feeling.
numb.zh: 我说不清自己有什么感觉。

numb.en: Can I talk to someone I trust?
numb.zh: 我能找信任的人聊聊吗？

overwhelmed-unmet.en: I have too much going on right now.
overwhelmed-unmet.zh: 我现在事情太多，快招架不住了。

overwhelmed-unmet.en: Everyone is asking me to do something.
Can we do one thing at a time?

panicky.en: Everything happened too fast for me.
panicky.zh: 事情发生得太快，我反应不过来。

panicky.en: Could we stop and breathe for a moment?
panicky.zh: 我们能停下来深呼吸一下吗？

passive.en: I have been letting others decide.
passive.zh: 我一直让别人替我决定。

passive.en: I did not say what I wanted.
passive.zh: 我刚才没说出自己的想法。

perplexed.zh: 这些说明把我弄糊涂了。

perplexed.en: Can we work through it together?

pessimistic.en: I keep expecting things to go wrong.
pessimistic.zh: 我总觉得事情会出问题。

pessimistic.en: I worry our plan might fail.
pessimistic.zh: 我担心我们的计划会失败。

pessimistic.en: Can we think of one thing that might go well?
pessimistic.zh: 我们能想想有什么可能会顺利吗？

puzzled.en: I do not understand how these pieces fit.
puzzled.zh: 我不知道这些零件怎么拼。

puzzled.en: Could you show me the first step?

rancorous.en: I am still carrying a grudge.
rancorous.zh: 我心里还记着那份怨气。

rancorous.en: I keep thinking about what felt unfair.
rancorous.zh: 我总想着那件不公平的事。

rancorous.en: Can we talk about it when I am ready?
rancorous.zh: 等我准备好了，我们能聊聊吗？

reluctant.en: I do not really want to do this.
I am not ready to share my toy yet.
reluctant.zh: 我还没准备好分享玩具。

reluctant.en: Could we talk about another way?
reluctant.zh: 我们能商量个别的办法吗？

repelled.en: I want to move away from that.
repelled.zh: 我想离那个东西远一点。

repelled.en: The smell makes me pull back.
repelled.zh: 那个味道让我忍不住往后退。

resentful.en: I still feel upset about being treated unfairly.
resentful.zh: 被不公平地对待，我心里还有怨气。

resentful.en: I wish someone had listened to me.
resentful.zh: 我希望有人能听我解释。

resentful.en: Could we talk about what happened?
resentful.zh: 我们能聊聊刚才发生的事吗？

restless.en: I keep getting up and walking around.
restless.zh: 我总忍不住站起来走来走去。

restless.en: Can I go outside for a little while?

sensitive-unmet.zh: 那些话让我心里很难受。

sensitive-unmet.en: I felt upset when someone laughed at me.
sensitive-unmet.zh: 有人笑话我时，我很难过。

sensitive-unmet.en: Could you speak to me more gently?
sensitive-unmet.zh: 你能对我说话温柔一点吗？

shaky.en: I feel nervous before going onstage.
Can we practice together once more?
shaky.zh: 我们能再一起练习一遍吗？

shocked.en: I did not see that coming.
Can you tell me what happened?
shocked.zh: 你能跟我说说发生了什么吗？

skeptical.en: I am not sure I believe that.
That story sounds hard to believe.
skeptical.zh: 那个故事听起来不太可信。

skeptical.en: Can we look for some evidence?
skeptical.zh: 我们能找些证据看看吗？

sleepy.en: My eyes keep closing after bedtime.
sleepy.zh: 过了睡觉时间，我的眼睛总想闭上。

sleepy.en: Can we go to bed now?
sleepy.zh: 我们现在可以睡觉了吗？

sorrowful.en: Thinking about that loss makes me tear up.
sorrowful.zh: 一想到失去的东西，我就想哭。

sorrowful.en: Could you sit with me for a while?

spiritless.en: I have no energy for this today.
spiritless.zh: 今天我做这件事没什么劲。

spiritless.en: I cannot get excited about our usual game.
spiritless.zh: 平时的游戏也让我提不起兴趣。
我们能做点轻松的事吗？

startled.en: Could you warn me next time?

surprised-unmet.en: The sudden change caught me off guard.
surprised-unmet.zh: 突然的变化让我措手不及。

surprised-unmet.en: Can you tell me what is happening?
surprised-unmet.zh: 你能告诉我发生什么了吗？

suspicious.en: Something about that story does not add up.
I am not sure it is true.
Can we check the facts together?

tepid.en: I am not very excited about that idea.
tepid.zh: 这个主意我不太感兴趣。

tepid.en: It sounds okay, but I am not eager to try.
tepid.zh: 听起来还行，可我并不太想试。

tepid.en: Could we think of another option?

terrified.en: That scary scene was too much for me.
terrified.zh: 刚才那个可怕的画面让我受不了。

terrified.en: Can we turn it off and sit together?
terrified.zh: 我们能关掉它，一起坐会儿吗？

troubled.en: I keep thinking about a problem.
Could I tell you what is on my mind?
troubled.zh: 我能跟你说说我的心事吗？

uncomfortable.en: Can I change into something else?

unconcerned.en: I am not worried about that.
I think it will work out fine.
Shall we focus on something else?

uneasy.zh: 我心里觉得有点不对劲。

uneasy.en: I am not sure why I feel nervous.
uneasy.zh: 我也不知道为什么有点紧张。

unglued.en: I am feeling out of control.
unglued.zh: 我现在有点控制不住情绪。

unglued.en: Everything seems too much at once.
unglued.zh: 好多事一下子压过来，我快受不了了。

unglued.en: Can we pause and help me calm down?
unglued.zh: 我们能先停一停，让我平静下来吗？

unhappy.en: I do not feel happy right now.
Things did not go the way I hoped.
unhappy.zh: 事情没有按我希望的那样发生。

unhappy.en: Could we do something comforting together?
unhappy.zh: 我们能一起做点让我舒服的事吗？

unnerved.en: That made me lose my nerve.
unnerved.zh: 那件事让我一下子紧张起来。

unnerved.en: I did not expect that loud sound.
unnerved.zh: 我没想到会有那样的响声。
我们能去安静点的地方吗？

unsteady.en: My legs are shaking after that jump.
unsteady.zh: 跳完以后我的腿有点发抖。

uptight.en: I keep worrying about every little detail.
uptight.zh: 我总忍不住担心每个小细节。

uptight.en: Can we take a short break?

vexed.en: I keep trying but cannot solve it.
vexed.zh: 我一直在试，却还是解不出来。

vexed.en: Can we think of another way?
vexed.zh: 我们能换个办法试试吗？

weary.en: That long day took so much energy.
weary.zh: 这一整天让我耗尽了力气。

wistful.zh: 我很怀念那些开心的日子。

wistful.en: That old photo makes me think of my friend.
wistful.zh: 那张旧照片让我想起朋友。

wistful.en: Could we look at more photos together?
wistful.zh: 我们能一起看看其他照片吗？

withdrawn.en: I want to keep to myself for a while.
withdrawn.zh: 我现在想一个人待会儿。

withdrawn.en: I have been quiet because I feel sad.
withdrawn.zh: 我有点难过，所以一直不想说话。

withdrawn.en: Could we talk a little later?

woeful.en: I cannot stop thinking about what happened.
woeful.zh: 我一直想着刚才发生的事。

woeful.en: Could you give me some comfort?

wretched.en: I feel really awful right now.
Everything seems to be going wrong today.
wretched.zh: 今天好像什么事都不顺。

wretched.en: Could we sit together and talk?
